newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Paris Hard Rock Cafe complains about closure.
newsitem.headline: Paris Hard Rock Cafe complains about closure.

text.p: Hard Rock Cafe, part of the American-style chain owned by the Rank Organisation Plc, said it complained to the European Union's executive body Tuesday about the closing of its restaurant in Paris.

French police closed the Hard Rock Cafe in Paris on Nov. 6 after about 660 pounds of frozen hamburger meet were found. Police said the meat was illegally impor????? had made fresh demands and in a surprise visit on Tuesday had complained that the empty premises were dusty.

A European Commission official confirmed that under a June ruling non-British beef could be processed in Britain in authorised factories and re-exported subject to strict controls on the origin of the meat and production methods.
But the French police consider the Commission's decision non-binding on French territory.
If the commission believes French police acted wrongly it could start proceedings against France on the grounds that it had infringed the EU treaty.
